name: Recollection 𝄇
source:
David often chooses to distance himself from his peers.
However, an encounter with classmates who share the same passion slowly opens him up?
This is the story of the Recollection cast's youth!

[From [url=https://kimiyoto.itch.io/recollection2]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大卫经常选择与同龄人保持距离。
然而，遇到志同道合的同学，却让他慢慢敞开心扉？
这就是《回忆》剧组的青春故事！

[来自[url=https://kimiyoto.itch.io/recollection2]itch.io[/url]]
